control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during start-up after maintenance on P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-9503 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 30 October 2025 an incident occurred on P-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
